{{sld|Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 241}}(as [[Jack O'Lantern]]) | Death = Venom Vol 2 11 | Death2 = (mentioned) | History = Danny Berkhart was paid by [[John Jonah Jameson (Earth-616)|J. Jonah Jameson]] to make [[Peter Parker (Earth-616)|Spider-Man]] think he was the ghost of the first [[Quentin Beck (Earth-616)|Mysterio]], who was faking his death at the time.{{r|Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 141|142}} After Berkhart was jailed, Jameson abandoned him, leading to Berkhart resenting Jameson. Jameson's role in this incident has ''still'' not been revealed to this day. When [[Norman Osborn (Earth-616)|Norman Osborn]] returned, an enigmatic [[Jack O'Lantern]] appeared, calling himself [[Mad Jack]]. He seemed to have a grudge with Jameson, and saved Spider-Man's life after having him defeated. Mad Jack's pet cat, [[Maguire (Cat) (Earth-616)|Maguire]], was very well-trained and obeyed Jack's every command. Jack beat Jameson to a pulp and blackmailed him into selling the ''[[Daily Bugle (The DB!) (Earth-616)|Daily Bugle]]'' to Osborn. When Osborn attempted to pay him for his services, Jack rejected payment, saying that he did it for pleasure.{{Citation}} [[File:Daniel Berkhart (Earth-616) from Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 241 001.jpeg|thumb|left|Berkhart as [[Jack O'Lantern]]]] Mad Jack was eventually revealed to be Danny Berkhart, working with [[Maguire Beck (Earth-616)|Maguire Beck]] (a cousin to Quentin Beck, the original Mysterio), who provided tech support.Shortly after the [[Clone Saga (Event)|Clone Saga]] Both had been tutored by Beck in his illusionist arts, and both took turns using the Mad Jack identity. Maguire was rarely in the costume, preferring to stay behind the scenes instead. For the riskiest assignments, they would put the costume on an android with Berkhart's face. Berkhart met [[Conundrum (Earth-616)|Conundrum]], and it was revealed that they were old acquaintances with a common past:{{r|Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 257}} they shared an "old man" as their tutor who was now dead.This indicates that Conundrum was also Mysterio's student. While fighting the Prodigy (who was actually Spider-Man at the time), Conundrum mentioned Jack's reflexes getting slower due to his age (indicating that Berkhart was the one in the costume at that time). The Prodigy/Spider-Man eventually figured out that by closing his eyes and relying only on his Spider-Sense, he had a better chance against the villains' illusionist attacks. While Peter knocked Conundrum out, Mad Jack was seemingly shot dead by one of Osborn's bodyguards. Jack's death was actually faked in order to serve the purposes of both Berkhart and Osborn. Mad Jack and a new Mysterio later tormented Spider-Man, Jameson, [[Matthew Murdock (Earth-616)|Daredevil]], and Just A Guy Named [[Joseph Smith (Earth-616)|Joe]].{{r|Spider-Man: Mysterio Manifesto Vol 1 1}} During these transgressions, it was revealed that Maguire had become the solo Jack O'Lantern, while Danny Berkhart assumed Mysterio's identity and became Beck's heir, reassuming his position as the second Mysterio. Maguire was captured as Mad Jack, while Berkhart escaped with his pet cat (which was also named Maguire).{{citation}} He apparently also sold a spare Mysterio costume and equipment to the [[Wilson Fisk (Earth-616)|Kingpin]] who, in turn, sold it to [[Francis Klum (Earth-616)|Francis Klum]]. Berkhart later battled Klum for the rights to the identity of Mysterio, even though he was the one who sold the costume originally. At this point, Berkhart stopped calling himself Mad Jack and continued on being only Mysterio.{{r|Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man Vol 1 11|13}} [[Jack O'Lantern (Crime-Master) (Earth-616)|The most recent man to assume the identity of Jack O'Lantern]] claimed that he had killed every other holder of the identity. Whether or not this included Berkhart is unknown, as he had long since given up that identity.{{r|Venom Vol 2 1}} | Powers = * {{Power|Illusions}} | Abilities = Like the original Mysterio, minimally enhanced speed / agility | Weaknesses = | Equipment = '''[[Mysterio Suit]]:''' Projectors, Gas Gloves, an Invisi-Mask, and Image Inducers, plus all of the tricks and gimmicks of the original Mysterio | Transportation = | Weapons = | Notes = | Trivia = * When [[J.M. DeMatteis intended to fill in the character's identity when he came up with a good idea for it, but had not yet decided who Mad Jack was going to be by the time that he left the book.{{cite|ref=true|url=https://www.cbr.com/spider-man-mad-jack-o-lantern-secret-identity-jm-dematteis/|title=Was Spider-Man Foe, Mad Jack, Created Without a Secret Identity?|work=CBR.com|first=Brian|last=Cronin|date=11 August 2019|accessdate=9 October 2019}} [[Tom DeFalco]] later decided to connect Mad Jack with Danny Berkhart in {{cl|Spider-Man: Mysterio Manifesto Vol 1 1}}. | Marvel = mysterio-daniel-berkhart | Wikipedia = Mysterio#Daniel Berkhart | Appendix = Appendix5/mysterioberkhart.htm | Links = }} [[Category:Killed Off-Panel]] [[Category: Alcoholism]]
